pl_ddr_region.capacity_basis: 2 GiB usable accelerator DDR under bare-metal; stack and heap excluded
pl_ddr_region.address_assignment: Resolve legal accelerator ranges from the bare-metal linker script and runtime memory allocation before execution; exclude application code/data, stack and heap
pl_ddr_region.range_rule: Require resolved address ranges; every transfer must lie entirely within an accelerator range and not overlap reserved application, stack or heap memory
